units.source_text: “眼下连我都痛苦到不得不想尽办法逃避租房押金呀。

en.t: Right now even I am suffering so much that I have to think of every possible way to avoid paying a rental deposit.

units.source_text: 人家催着要租房押金，才搬离这回住的家。

en.t: When the landlord presses me for the rental deposit, I move out of the place I am living in at the time.

units.source_text: 用搬了又迁的办法，来逃避缴纳两三个月的押金啊！”

en.t: By moving and then moving again, I dodge having to pay two or three months' worth of deposit!
